seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Plymouth, Minnesota for 2026: Santa Visits the Sensory Room at the Plymouth Community Center on December 6.
lede: Plymouth offers a calm way to see Santa, with a sensory-friendly visit at the Plymouth Community Center.
celebrates: The City of Plymouth leans on its community center for holiday fun. Santa Visits the Sensory Room on December 6 gives children who find the holiday season overwhelming a calming space for a 10-minute one-on-one visit, plus crafts, therapy animals and sensory play. The center also has an indoor playground called the K.U.B.E. for ages 2 to 12. Local restaurants and taprooms such as Johnny Mac's and Luce Line Brewing also host Santa days, according to their own pages.
lastyear: Plymouth's recreation department runs sensory and adaptive programs through the year, according to a city news item, and the Santa Visits the Sensory Room event is one of them. The city's community center site lists activities year round. We did not find a Plymouth-specific recap of the 2025 holiday season on a host page.
facts: The Plymouth Community Center is at 14800 34th Avenue North. Its K.U.B.E., short for Kids Ultimate Backyard Experience, is an indoor playground for ages 2 to 12. The city describes its sensory room as a calming space for children whose senses are overwhelmed by holiday noise, smells, lights and crowds.
trains: We did not find a Plymouth train ride. The closest rail options are CPKC's Holiday Train stop in Golden Valley on December 14, the Everly Express at Everly Farms in Minnetrista, and the Holly Trolley in Minneapolis from the Minnesota Streetcar Museum.
